measurement.basis: Foot length (heel to longest toe) AND ball width. Men's and women's charts are separate lasts: the same US-W size maps to a different length and EU number on each chart (see quirks). US women = US men + 1.5.
how_to_measure_adult: Print the sizing tool at 100% scale; check the scale with a credit card.
Place heel on the semicircle, back of heel against the paper edge or a wall; read length at the longest toe.
Width: measure the widest part of each foot horizontally (ball width); compare with the size/width chart on a product page.
how_to_measure_kids: Child steps on the tool with full weight, heel on the designated line; mark the longest toe. Measure the other foot too.
Use the longest measurement, rounding up if between sizes.
Width: cut the circumference ruler from the tool and wrap it around the largest point of the foot; repeat on the other foot, use the largest.
measurement.in_between_sizes: Choose the larger size if between sizes, or if one foot is longer than the other. Adjust with socks, insoles, lacing.
measurement.fit_note: Measure in the late afternoon when feet are largest. Heel snug with no slipping; midfoot snug not tight; room to wiggle toes. Re-measure every year (kids every 2-4 months). Feet can differ left/right by up to a full size; buy for the larger foot.

widths.men: B narrow, D standard, 2E wide, 4E x-wide
widths.women: 2A narrow, B standard, D wide, 2E x-wide
widths.kids: M standard, W wide, XW x-wide

quirks: Men's and women's length charts disagree: men's chart lists US-W 9.5 at 26.0 cm / EU 41.5, women's chart lists US-W 9.5 at 26.5 cm / EU 41. The women's chart runs 0.5 cm longer per size than the men's cross-reference column; EU differs by 0.5 on most rows; UK agrees. Use the chart for the gender of the shoe, not the cross-reference column.
US women = US men + 1.5 (adidas uses +1).
Half sizes stop at US-M 14 / US-W 14; above that whole sizes at 1 cm steps. EU steps are irregular (0.5 or 1).
Printable measuring tools (PDF) agree with the web charts: men 22-38 cm = US-M 4-20, women 21-32 cm = US-W 4-15, kids 8-25 cm = US 0-7, all 1 cm per whole size.

Source errors kept as published: Little Kid US 2.5 lists UK '5' (pattern says 2); Babies US 1 lists 8.5 cm as 3 1/8 in (8.5 cm = 3 3/8); Little Kid US 2 lists 20 cm as 7 5/8 in (20 cm = 7 7/8); cm repeats on adjacent half sizes in babies (US 2.5/3, 5/5.5, 8.5/9) and little kid (11.5/12, 13.5/1).
Width source errors kept as published: babies X-Wide at US 5.5-7.5 repeats the Wide cm values (15.1, 15.3, 15.5, 15.8) while its inch column keeps climbing.
Kids charts cross-reference US men/women only from Little Kid 1.5 upward (US men = kids size, US women = kids + 1.5).
